item.title: Bad Bunny’s Super Bowl 2026 Show Was a Joyful Act of Resilience—and Resistance
item.description: It was one of the most feverishly-anticipated, instantly-controversial halftime shows in history. You didn’t need to know Spanish to grasp the message: Puerto Rico is America; fiesta is a form of protest; joy is a kind of rebellion.

item.title: Timothée Chalamet Deserves an Oscar for His Table Tennis Alone
item.description: Take it from Diego Schaaf, who taught the Marty Supreme star how to play: “I could see immediately the guy knows how to move; he’s in very good control of his body.”

item.title: Prince William and Kate Middleton Are “Deeply Concerned” by the Latest Epstein Files Release
item.description: Ahead of Prince William’s three-day trip to Saudi Arabia, a spokesperson for the Prince and Princess of Wales has addressed the recent release of files related to Jeffrey Epstein, which included incriminating photographs of Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor.

item.title: Robert Evans’s Legendary Memoir Captures an Epic Hollywood Rise and Fall
item.description: The man behind Chinatown, The Godfather, Rosemary’s Baby, and endless anecdotes recalls his high highs and low lows with characteristic swagger in The Kid Stays in the Picture, his peerless autobiography.
